scenarios_executed.title: Regulatory evidence retrieval — S.4.3 validation
scenarios_executed.query: What are the ICH requirements for analytical procedure validation under CTD section 3.2.S.4.3?
scenarios_executed.details: Found 3 relevant sources from 15 candidate chunks using BGE (bge-large-en-v1.5) + ChromaDB. Top result: ICH-Q14 (Analytical Procedure Development), score=0.8098, section 3.2.S.4.3. Real BGE embeddings confirmed. Citation ID, passage text, authority, version all displayed.

scenarios_executed.title: Provisional S.4 assessment — Valsartan S.4.1
scenarios_executed.details: Dual-panel display: regulatory evidence (ICH-M4Q-R1, score=0.787) shown separately from sponsor dossier evidence (dossier_valsartan_edited_validation...). Both panels displayed correct source types. Provisional finding panel shown with human-review requirement. No mixing of sources between panels.

scenarios_executed.title: Source isolation — collection separation
scenarios_executed.details: ChromaDB isolation confirmed: 0 dossier chunks in regulatory collection, 0 regulatory chunks in dossier collection. Quarantine HTML not indexed in either collection. Compendial discovery (7064 docs) in SQLite only, not in ChromaDB.

scenarios_not_run_in_browser.title: Drug-substance document navigation (KB Browser)
scenarios_not_run_in_browser.note: KB Browser page loads dossier source metadata from audit. Dossier PDFs confirmed present in pharmacopoeia/incoming/raw_from_pharmacy/ (45 files). 43 have indexed chunks. Not browser-click-tested due to BGE load time.

scenarios_not_run_in_browser.title: Missing evidence abstention
scenarios_not_run_in_browser.note: app.py page_evidence_search() returns 'Insufficient evidence' message when results list is empty. Relies on BGE returning low-score results for off-corpus queries. Not click-tested.

warnings: BGE model takes ~30s to load on first use (1.3GB cached model).
App uses BGE query prefix 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:' per bge-large-en-v1.5 convention.
